decks.notes: This deck focuses on using disruptive creatures and spells to control the opponent's board while aggressively applying pressure with efficient attackers. By combining powerful cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Stoneforge Mystic with disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Swords to Plowshares, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly closing out the game with large threats. The deck also utilizes cards like Aether Vial and Karakas to provide additional utility and flexibility in dealing with a variety of threats and strategies.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures such as Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty from the graveyard using cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Shallow Grave. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Unmask to clear the way for the combo. It uses mana acceleration with cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to get these reanimation spells out as quickly as possible. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures before they have a chance to react.

The main concept of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. The deck aims to control the game by using cards like Force of Will, Brainstorm, and Lightning Bolt to keep the opponent's threats in check, while also utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Kolaghan's Command to disrupt their hand and resources. Additionally, the deck includes powerful threats like Baleful Strix and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. It uses cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to control the board, along with disruptive creatures like Meddling Mage and Skyclave Apparition. Aether Vial allows for quick creature deployment, while the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value by flickering cards like Soulherder and Palace Jailer. The deck also utilizes powerful cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Karakas to further disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize powerful artifacts to create a prison-like control strategy, preventing the opponent from effectively playing spells or advancing their game plan. Cards like Chalice of the Void, Trinisphere, and Karn, the Great Creator are used to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while cards like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and The One Ring provide powerful threats to close out the game. By using an abundance of artifact-based control elements, this deck aims to lock down the board and control the game until victory is achieved.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By utilizing cards like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride, the deck can put pressure on the opponent early in the game. Additionally, cards like Swords to Plowshares and Goblin Bombardment provide removal options to deal with threats from the opponent. The deck also includes some disruptive elements like Static Prison and Hexing Squelcher to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to be proactive and aggressive while maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to repeatedly recur and exchange artifacts from the graveyard to create powerful combos and synergies. Emry, Lurker of the Loch also aids in graveyard recursion, while cards like Urza's Saga and Lotus Petal provide additional utility and mana ramp. The presence of Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Bauble allows for card advantage and selection. The deck aims to set up explosive plays and overwhelming board presence through the strategic manipulation of artifacts.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of efficient creatures and disruption spells to apply pressure on the opponent while controlling the board. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Swords to Plowshares, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while developing its own board presence quickly with cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Noble Hierarch. The inclusion of cards like Endurance and Gaddock Teeg also provide additional disruption against combo and spell-heavy decks, making it difficult for opponents to navigate their strategy effectively.

The deck focuses on using cards like Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to recur artifacts from the graveyard and take advantage of cards like Urza's Saga to create powerful artifact-based combos. The goal is to assemble pieces quickly with cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mox Opal, while also having disruptive elements like Loki, God of Mischief and Phyrexian Dragon Engine. The deck utilizes a mix of mana acceleration, card advantage, and artifact synergy to overwhelm opponents with its combo potential and board presence.

This Bant Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful planeswalkers and disruptive spells to control the game and outvalue opponents. It aims to control the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Leyline Binding, while also providing card advantage with Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. Murktide Regent provides a strong threat while Quantum Riddler offers additional card selection. The deck also includes counter magic in the form of Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its game plan. Wrath of the Skies serves as a board wipe option, cementing the deck's control strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing lands and control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating value. It aims to quickly assemble the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Indestructible Marit Lage token, while using cards like Life from the Loam and Exploration to fuel consistent land drops and recursion. The deck also includes disruptive elements such as Wasteland and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale to slow down the opponent's resources. Overall, the deck aims to lock down the board and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful land strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifact ramp and interaction to assemble the Mystic Forge combo, which allows the player to cast cards from the top of their library. The deck includes various ways to untap artifacts, generate mana, and control the game with disruptive cards like Karn, the Great Creator. By combining efficient artifact mana acceleration with powerful payoffs like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Tezzeret, Cruel Captain, the player aims to generate a large advantage and win the game through overwhelming card advantage and powerful threats.

The deck focuses on quickly getting Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis onto the battlefield by utilizing cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Once Upon a Time to fill the graveyard. It also uses cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck includes various lands to support the combo, such as Bayou and Wasteland, and has backup win conditions like Wight of the Reliquary and Orcish Bowmasters. The overall strategy is to outpace the opponent and overwhelm them with powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively control the game by utilizing efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Questing Druid, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counter spells like Daze and Force of Will, while also maintaining card advantage and consistency with cards like Ponder, Brainstorm, and Mishra's Bauble. The mana base includes dual lands to ensure smooth casting of spells, along with Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient spells to put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. By combining aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler with powerful instant spells like Lightning Bolt and Daze, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and quickly close out victories. The mana base is streamlined and focused on enabling early aggression, while also providing some resilience with cards like Wasteland and Mystic Sanctuary. Overall, the deck aims to win through relentless pressure and efficient interaction.

This Control-Pox deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's resources through discard spells like Hymn to Tourach and Thoughtseize, and land destruction with cards like Wasteland and Sinkhole. It also utilizes Smallpox to further strip the opponent of resources while keeping the board clear, and uses The Rack as a win condition alongside Dauthi Voidwalker and other creatures to pressure the opponent. The deck also incorporates cards like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Zuran Orb for mana fixing and lifegain, creating a grindy and resource-denying playstyle.
